note: Part-specific household refs; grams per unit are USDA/Serious-Eats style kitchen standards, cited in basis. Suite refs are never redefined here.

lettuce_leaf.basis: USDA romaine: 1 cup shredded 47g; a large outer leaf ~30g

brown_sugar_tsp.basis: USDA: brown sugar 1 cup packed 220g -> 1 tsp ~4.6g, rounded to 4g

sugar_tsp.basis: USDA: granulated sugar 1 cup 200g -> 1 tsp ~4.2g, rounded to 4g

sesame_seeds_tsp.basis: USDA: whole sesame seeds 1 tbsp ~9g -> 1 tsp ~3g

chili_pepper_piece.basis: bird's-eye/Thai chili: 1 small pepper ~3g (USDA hot red chili range 2-4g)

rice_noodles_oz_dry.basis: dry noodle standard: 1 oz = 28g (matches suite dry_pasta_oz); rice vermicelli nests weigh the same dry
